cards.title: Three children and teacher killed in US primary school shooting
cards.titleEn: Three children and teacher killed in US primary school shooting
cards.titleKo: 미국 오리건주 초등학교 총격…어린이 3명과 교사 사망
cards.summary: The suspect was shot dead by a community member who followed him into the Oregon school, police said. A 16-year-old has shot dead three children and a teacher at a primary school in the US state of Oregon before he was killed by a bystander, police said.
cards.summaryEn: The suspect was shot dead by a community member who followed him into the Oregon school, police said. A 16-year-old has shot dead three children and a teacher at a primary school in the US state of Oregon before he was killed by a bystander, police said.
cards.summaryKo: 미국 오리건주의 한 초등학교에서 총격 사건이 발생해 어린이 3명과 교사 1명이 숨졌다. 당국은 사건의 경위와 피해 상황을 조사하고 있다.
points: The suspect, who has not been named, forced his way into Silver Rail Elementary School in the city of Bend on Thursday afternoon by shooting at locked doors, Bend Police Chief Mike Krantz said.
The teenager was shot dead by a community member who "pursued him into the school and engaged him", Krantz said.
The three children killed were aged five, eight and 11.
pointsKo: 수사 당국은 사건의 구체적인 경위를 확인하고 있다.
pointsEn: The suspect, who has not been named, forced his way into Silver Rail Elementary School in the city of Bend on Thursday afternoon by shooting at locked doors, Bend Police Chief Mike Krantz said.
The teenager was shot dead by a community member who "pursued him into the school and engaged him", Krantz said.
The three children killed were aged five, eight and 11.

cards.title: Alone in Gaza: Genocide leaves Palestinian man without family or a home
cards.titleEn: Alone in Gaza: Genocide leaves Palestinian man without family or a home
cards.titleKo: 가자지구에서 홀로 남겨진 남성…전쟁으로 가족과 집 잃어
cards.summary: One man wanders Gaza in search of somewhere to sleep, having lost his family in an Israeli strike. Gaza City, Gaza Strip – Every morning, Mahmoud Khalla goes to the nearby cemetery to visit the graves of the family members he lost during Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza.
cards.summaryEn: One man wanders Gaza in search of somewhere to sleep, having lost his family in an Israeli strike. Gaza City, Gaza Strip – Every morning, Mahmoud Khalla goes to the nearby cemetery to visit the graves of the family members he lost during Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza.
cards.summaryKo: 가자지구의 한 남성이 전쟁으로 가족과 집을 잃고 홀로 살아가고 있다. 그의 이야기는 전쟁이 민간인의 삶과 가족 공동체에 남긴 깊은 상실을 보여준다.
points: He has held on to this morning routine in the months since he buried them, imagining his family is still around.
For Mahmoud, 40, the cemetery is the resting place of some of the people he has loved the most in his life.

His wife, his three children, his parents, his two brothers and their families, his sister and her children, and other relatives had all gathered in their family home in Jabalia, northern Gaza, on December 21, 2023.
pointsKo: 전쟁으로 가족과 거처를 잃은 주민의 삶을 조명한다.
개인의 경험을 통해 가자지구 민간인이 겪는 인도주의적 위기를 살펴본다.
pointsEn: He has held on to this morning routine in the months since he buried them, imagining his family is still around.
For Mahmoud, 40, the cemetery is the resting place of some of the people he has loved the most in his life.

His wife, his three children, his parents, his two brothers and their families, his sister and her children, and other relatives had all gathered in their family home in Jabalia, northern Gaza, on December 21, 2023.

cards.titleEn: Banks say Healey planning to increase tax on their profits in Budget
cards.titleKo: 영국 은행권, 예산안의 이익세 인상 가능성에 촉각
cards.summary: Senior banking executives have told the BBC they expect to be "on the menu" in the chancellor's Budget tax later this month. The Chancellor, John Healey, is planning to increase taxes on bank profits, senior banking executives have told the BBC.
cards.summaryEn: Senior banking executives have told the BBC they expect to be "on the menu" in the chancellor's Budget tax later this month. The Chancellor, John Healey, is planning to increase taxes on bank profits, senior banking executives have told the BBC.
cards.summaryKo: 영국 은행권은 정부가 예산안에서 은행 이익에 대한 세금을 인상할 수 있다는 보도에 주목하고 있다. 세금 변경 가능성은 은행의 수익과 정부의 재정 정책 논의에 영향을 줄 수 있다.
points: Healey has described banks as part of "the crown jewels" of the UK economy, but leaders in the sector have said it will be "on the menu" at the Budget in two weeks' time.
The biggest four banks collectively made about £15bn profit in the first six months of this year, and trade unions have called for them to face additional taxes.

The trade body for the banking sector, UK Finance, warned "further increases in bank taxes would weaken competitiveness, discourage investment and job creation, and work against the government's ambition to deliver gr…
pointsKo: 은행들은 예산안에 포함될 수 있는 이익세 변경을 주시하고 있다.
실제 세율 변경 여부와 적용 방식은 정부의 예산안 발표를 확인해야 한다.

cards.title: A telling hole in a Neandertal bone hints at a bitter end
cards.titleEn: A telling hole in a Neandertal bone hints at a bitter end
cards.titleKo: 네안데르탈인 뼈의 구멍, 창에 찔린 흔적일까
cards.summary: An excavation at an iconic Neandertal burial site uncovers evidence for one individual's potential fatal wound as well as an injury endured for years. Freda Kreier was a fall 2021 intern at Science News.
cards.summaryEn: An excavation at an iconic Neandertal burial site uncovers evidence for one individual's potential fatal wound as well as an injury endured for years. Freda Kreier was a fall 2021 intern at Science News.
cards.summaryKo: 네안데르탈인의 뼈에서 발견된 구멍이 창에 의한 상처일 가능성을 시사한다. 연구자들은 이 흔적이 당시의 부상이나 죽음과 관련이 있는지 살펴보고 있으며, 해석에는 신중함이 필요하다.
points: She holds a bachelor’s degree in molecular biology from Colorado College and a master’s in science communication from the University of California, Santa Cruz.
A hole in this 75,000-year-old shoulder blade suggests that this Neandertal was stabbed by a spear around the time they died.
A new set of remains found in modern-day Iraq suggests that one Neandertal probably suffered a devastating blow to the face before dying at the point of a spear many years later.
pointsKo: 뼈에 남은 구멍이 창과 관련된 손상인지 분석하고 있다.
이 흔적만으로 사망 원인을 확정할 수는 없으며 추가 해석이 필요하다.
pointsEn: She holds a bachelor’s degree in molecular biology from Colorado College and a master’s in science communication from the University of California, Santa Cruz.
A hole in this 75,000-year-old shoulder blade suggests that this Neandertal was stabbed by a spear around the time they died.
A new set of remains found in modern-day Iraq suggests that one Neandertal probably suffered a devastating blow to the face before dying at the point of a spear many years later.

cards.title: NASA captures strange waves high above Hurricane Simon
cards.titleEn: NASA captures strange waves high above Hurricane Simon
cards.titleKo: NASA 위성, 허리케인 사이먼 상공의 대기 중력파 포착
cards.summary: NASA satellite observations captured atmospheric gravity waves spreading above Hurricane Simon. The waves formed when powerful storm-driven updrafts disturbed the upper atmosphere, and faint airglow helped make the ripples visible from space.
cards.summaryEn: NASA satellite observations captured atmospheric gravity waves spreading above Hurricane Simon. The waves formed when powerful storm-driven updrafts disturbed the upper atmosphere, and faint airglow helped make the ripples visible from space.
cards.summaryKo: NASA 위성이 허리케인 사이먼 위쪽 대기에서 퍼져 나가는 대기 중력파를 포착했다. 폭풍의 강한 상승기류가 상층 대기를 흔들어 파동을 만들었고, 희미한 대기광 덕분에 위성 영상에서 물결무늬를 확인할 수 있었다.
points: The storm's powerful updrafts disturbed the upper atmosphere, generating waves that traveled toward the stratosphere and mesosphere.
Very low moonlight made the faint airglow patterns easier for satellite instruments to detect.
pointsKo: 폭풍 내부의 강한 상승기류가 상층 대기를 흔들어 대기 중력파를 만들었다.
달빛이 적은 관측 조건에서 희미한 대기광의 변화가 위성 영상에 포착됐다.
pointsEn: The storm's powerful updrafts disturbed the upper atmosphere, generating waves that traveled toward the stratosphere and mesosphere.
Very low moonlight made the faint airglow patterns easier for satellite instruments to detect.
cards.summarySource: ScienceDaily article, original source NASA Earth Observatory

cards.title: Trump waives key Russia-related sanctions and tariffs before they take effect
cards.titleEn: Trump waives key Russia-related sanctions and tariffs before they take effect
cards.titleKo: 미국, 러시아 관련 주요 제재·관세 시행 유예
cards.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump issued an executive order waiving significant Russia-related sanctions and tariffs before they took effect. The move was justified on national-interest grounds, including concerns about adding pressure to already high energy prices, and has drawn criticism from lawmakers.
cards.summaryEn: U.S. President Donald Trump issued an executive order waiving significant Russia-related sanctions and tariffs before they took effect. The move was justified on national-interest grounds, including concerns about adding pressure to already high energy prices, and has drawn criticism from lawmakers.
cards.summaryKo: 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 시행을 앞둔 러시아 관련 주요 제재와 관세를 유예하는 행정명령을 내렸다. 정부는 국가 이익과 이미 높은 에너지 가격에 대한 부담 등을 이유로 들었으며, 이번 조치는 의회 일부 인사들의 비판을 받고 있다.
points: The waiver affects measures intended to penalize Russia and countries buying its energy.
Supporters and critics disagree over the effects on energy prices and pressure on Russia.
pointsEn: The waiver affects measures intended to penalize Russia and countries buying its energy.
Supporters and critics disagree over the effects on energy prices and pressure on Russia.
pointsKo: 이번 유예는 러시아와 러시아산 에너지를 구매하는 국가를 겨냥한 조치에 영향을 준다.
에너지 가격과 러시아에 대한 압박에 미칠 영향을 두고 찬반 논쟁이 이어지고 있다.
